content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Aerospace components and aftermarket repair sold to airlines and defense, overlapping Crane's aerospace aftermarket and components business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Trades and leases used aircraft and engines, a different asset-trading business from Crane's manufacturing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Electric motors and motion control for equipment makers, not valves, pumps or aerospace components."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt plants and road and mining machinery, a different equipment business with different customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and coatings for construction, unlike Crane's valves, pumps and aerospace parts."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Roof coatings, HVAC and building products, mostly construction; its industrial valves are a minor part."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mainly utility smart meters and test equipment; its aerospace valves are only one of several separate businesses."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Pumps and valves sold to oil, chemical and industrial operators, plus aerospace connectors and aftermarket parts, closely matching Crane."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Engines and generator sets for equipment makers, not valves, pumps or aerospace components."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical process fluids, lubricants and coatings, not manufactured valves, pumps or components."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Precision bearings and engineered components for aerospace and defense OEMs, sharing Crane's aerospace component customers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments for buildings and transit, a different business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hardware and security products for equipment makers, unrelated to Crane's valves, pumps and aerospace."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Designs and manufactures pumps for industrial, petroleum and defense customers, the same core product as Crane's pumps."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Bearings and power transmission products for vehicles and machinery, not valves, pumps or aerospace systems."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Process heat tracing and heating systems, serving the same plants but a different product category."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Custom foam and plastic components made to OEM specs, a contract molding business rather than valves or pumps."},{"label":"C18","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers plus water quality instruments, unlike Crane's valves, pumps and aerospace components."}]}
